entries.source: Lorenz Fries, Hohe Registratur, entry 2787, Standbuch 1012, Folio: 460v, Schreiber:
entries.german: Wie B. Johanns von Brun den Truchsessen, Berlichingen vnd Conraden von Rosenberg der 8000 f halben ein ander verschribung geben Recepta Contractarum Brun folio i anno 1413 Montag nach Sant Mathei tag
entries.english: Johann von Brunn, Bischof, issued another bond to the Truchsessen, Berlichingen, and Konrad von Rosenberg concerning the 8,000 florins. Recorded in the register of contracts of Brun, fol. 1, in 1413, on the Monday after St Matthew’s Day.

facts.content: received another bond from Bishop Johann von Brunn concerning the 8,000 florins, jointly with the Truchsessen and Berlichingen.
